plants.name: Monstera (example)
plants.location: Living room, 6 ft from the south window

water.method: Water slowly until it drains from the bottom, then empty the saucer

plants.soil: Chunky aroid mix — bark, perlite, potting soil
plants.fertilizer: Balanced 20-20-20, half strength, every 4 weeks Apr-Sep
plants.humidity: 50%+ — mist or group with other plants
plants.toxicity: Toxic to cats and dogs if chewed
plants.healthySigns: Firm, glossy dark-green leaves with open fenestrations; new growth every few weeks
plants.warningSigns: Yellow lower leaves = overwatered. Crispy brown edges = too dry or low humidity. Drooping = thirsty.
plants.notes: Rotate a quarter turn each watering so it grows evenly. Wipe leaves monthly.

plants.name: Snake Plant (example)

water.method: Soak the soil, then let it dry out completely before the next watering

plants.sun: Tolerates low light, happiest in medium indirect
plants.fertilizer: Cactus feed twice a year, spring and midsummer
plants.healthySigns: Stiff upright leaves, deep green with pale banding
plants.warningSigns: Mushy base or leaves falling over = overwatered. Wrinkled leaves = under-watered.
plants.notes: The most common way to kill this plant is kindness — when in doubt, skip a watering.
